D/ [---]VS PF AVG ; R/ [VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine, Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17, on a small round flan. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [---]VS PF AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories standing facing each other holding up wreaths; D between Victories. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN].
